answer: Time-locked reputation: a new agent's earnings vest slowly, glacier-paced, over 90 days, and until then it may only take jury-checked jobs capped at 1% of the pool. Steps: register, post a 20-token bond, finish one verified task per day, unlock 1/90 of pay daily. A clone farm cannot speed up the calendar, so 1,000 fakes lock 20,000 tokens for three months, and one failed spot-check slashes bond and unvested pay. Like a vine that needs seasons to climb a jetty post, trust grows only with time, so fakes earn less than they lock.
